items.docs:
Public webhook endpoint. Receives payloads and triggers agent runs.

Authentication is via the webhook_token in the URL.
Optional HMAC-SHA256 signature verification via X-Webhook-Signature header.

Handle Clerk webhook events

Events handled:
- organization.created: Create organization in our database
- organization.updated: Update organization in our database
- organization.deleted: Delete organization from our database
- organizationMembership.created: Link user to organization
- organizationMembership.updated: Update user role
- organizationMembership.deleted: Unlink user from organization
- user.created: Create user in our database
- user.updated: Update user in our database
- user.del

Handle Recall.ai meeting-bot webhooks.

When a bot finishes (status ``done``), enqueue transcript ingestion;
the heavy work (fetch transcript, create meetings, extract tickets)
runs in a Celery task so the handler returns 200 quickly.
